effect: The reservoir and bed drains are connected, completing the shared water-return system and the chapter goals.
reaction: The separate root-zone adjustments make the shared system feel thoughtfully designed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the reservoir connection was most worthwhile: it brought the separate drain runs, pump and distribution line together while explaining how the root zones retain individual adjustments.

leastWorthwhile.text: The reservoir assembly was the least clear passage: the earlier drain description sounded as though the connection to the reservoir was already underway, yet a separate hose assembly was still needed.

surprise.text: The reservoir and pump had to be combined with the hose before they could connect to the drained beds; the failed attempt automatically revealed and performed that assembly.

arbitrary.text: That intermediate hose assembly felt somewhat arbitrary because the preceding result did not clearly distinguish the bed drain runs from the reservoir's own return hose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the distinct bed designs and explanation of the water circuit made the construction engaging, though clearer plumbing descriptions would help.
